question: What has been transmitted to the addressee concerning the practice related to the soul?
premises: The addressee is addressed as Bhairavī.
This practice of the soul has been told.
It has been told to the addressee.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The details of that practice are not given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
